docs.title: Arkeo All-in-One API Documentation
docs.text:
The Arkeo All-in-One API allows external applications to control and query the Arkeo measurement software through a TCP/JSON interface.

Each connected client can send JSON-encoded requests and receive JSON responses. All commands follow a standard message structure containing a target, a command, optional parameters, and a request ID to match responses.

docs.title: 🔧 Request Format
docs.text:
Every request message must contain the following JSON structure:

{
  "target": "<TARGET>",
  "command": "<COMMAND>",
  "params": { ... },
  "request_id": 42
}
````

* **target**: Specifies which subsystem should handle the command.
  Example targets: `"MAIN"`, `"ROUTINE"`, `"TMPCTL"`, `"MUX"`.
* **command**: The specific instruction for that target.
* **params**: Optional command parameters (may be empty `{}`).
* **request_id**: An integer identifier assigned by the client.

---

## Response Format

Each command returns a structured JSON response. The response always includes
a `status` field and the same `request_id` as the corresponding request.

```json
{
  "status": "OK" | "ERROR",
  "data": { ... },     // present if status = "OK"
  "error": { ... },    // present if status = "ERROR"
  "request_id": 42
}

docs.title: Response Keys
docs.text:
• status: Indicates success or failure ("OK" or "ERROR").
  • data: Command-specific response payload.
  • error: Only present if an error occurred; contains fields such as:

json { "code": 101, "message": "Invalid parameters" } * request_id: Echoes the ID from the request.

docs.title: Targets Overview
docs.text: Target Description MAIN Controls system-wide operations, including routine activation. ROUTINE Handles measurement routines such as JV, MPPT, Impedance, and Luminescence. TMPCTL Controls and monitors temperature controllers. MUX Manages multiplexer connections.

docs.title: MAIN Commands
docs.text: Commands in this section control the high-level state of the Arkeo All-in-One application. They are responsible for selecting and managing routines.

docs.title: Command Index
docs.text: Command Description StartRoutine Launch a measurement routine by name. GetActiveRoutine Query which routine is currently active. GetAvailableRoutines Retrieve the list of available routine plugins. CloseRoutine Stop and unload the active routine.

docs.title: StartRoutine
docs.text: Description Starts a measurement routine by name. Only one routine can be active at a time.

docs.title: GetActiveRoutine
docs.text: Description Returns the name of the currently active routine. If no routine is active, an empty string is returned.

docs.title: GetAvailableRoutines
docs.text: Description Returns a list of all available routine plugins that can be loaded.

docs.title: CloseRoutine
docs.text: Description Stops and unloads the currently active routine. The system will return to the idle state.

docs.title: MUX Commands
docs.text: The multiplexer (MUX) target provides commands to control channel connections. Each channel can be individually connected or disconnected, or all channels can be updated simultaneously.

docs.title: Command Index
docs.text: Command Description Connect Connect a specific channel. Disconnect Disconnect a specific channel. GetStatus Retrieve the connection status of all channels. SetStatus Set the connection state for all channels at once.

docs.title: Connect
docs.text: Description Connects a specific channel on the multiplexer. If the channel is already connected, this command has no effect.

docs.title: Disconnect
docs.text: Description Disconnects a specific channel on the multiplexer. If the channel is already disconnected, the command has no effect.

docs.title: GetStatus
docs.text: Description Returns the connection status of all multiplexer channels as a Boolean array. Each element represents one channel, where true means connected and false means disconnected.

docs.title: SetStatus
docs.text: Description Sets the connection status for all channels simultaneously. Each Boolean value in the channels array represents one channel’s desired state.

docs.title: ROUTINE Commands
docs.text: Commands in this section are shared across all measurement routines. Each routine can be started from the MAIN target, after which the commands below control the measurement process, retrieve results, and manage settings.

docs.title: Command Index
docs.text: Command Description StartMeasurement Start a measurement within the active routine. StopMeasurement Stop the current measurement. ApplySettings Apply configuration parameters to the routine. LoadSettings Retrieve the current routine configuration. GetStatus Query the routine’s current operational state. GetTestData Retrieve the most recent measurement data.

docs.title: StartMeasurement
docs.text: Description Starts a measurement using the currently active routine.

docs.title: StopMeasurement
docs.text: Description Stops the running measurement. If no measurement is active, the command will return without error.

docs.title: ApplySettings
docs.text: Description Applies a set of configuration parameters to the active routine. Parameters are specific to the routine and provided as a JSON object.

docs.title: LoadSettings
docs.text: Description Retrieves the current configuration of the routine.

docs.title: GetStatus
docs.text: Description Retrieves the current operational state of the routine, including progress and error information.

docs.title: Routine Status Values
docs.text: Value Description Initializing Routine is loading or configuring resources. Ready Routine is idle and ready to start. Starting Routine has received a start command and is preparing measurement. Running Measurement is in progress. Error Routine encountered an error.

docs.title: GetTestData
docs.text: Description Retrieves the most recent test or measurement data from the active routine.

docs.title: Luminescence Routine Commands
docs.text: This section lists the commands specific to the Luminescence routine. These commands allow acquisition of luminescence spectra, automatic exposure adjustment, and control of laser excitation.

docs.title: Command Index
docs.text: Command Description AcquireDark / AcquireReference Capture a dark or reference spectrum. AcquireSingle Acquire a single luminescence spectrum. AutoExposure Automatically determine optimal integration time. SetLaser Enable or disable the excitation laser.

docs.title: AcquireDark / AcquireReference
docs.text: Description Captures a dark or reference spectrum and stores it in memory. If reference is set to false, a dark spectrum is acquired. If reference is set to true, a reference spectrum is acquired.

docs.title: AcquireSingle
docs.text: Description Performs a single luminescence measurement using the current settings. The resulting spectrum is returned as an array of intensity values.

docs.title: AutoExposure
docs.text: Description Determines the optimal integration time for luminescence acquisition by iteratively measuring signal intensity. The result includes the selected exposure time in milliseconds.

docs.title: SetLaser
docs.text: Description Controls the excitation laser used during luminescence measurements. Setting enabled to true turns the laser on, while false turns it off.
